name: vanuikit-demo
description: Demo de vanuikit: login, registro, dashboard y catálogo de componentes. Consume vanuikit exclusivamente como paquete (workspace), sin rutas al fuente.

scripts.clean: node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }))"
scripts.build:client: npm run clean && esbuild main.ts --bundle --outdir=dist --format=esm --splitting --metafile=dist/meta.json && node scripts/check-single-vanjs.js && npm run uno
scripts.build:min: npm run clean && esbuild main.ts --bundle --outdir=dist --format=esm --splitting --minify --sourcemap=external --metafile=dist/meta.json && node scripts/check-single-vanjs.js && npm run uno && node scripts/compress.js
